column1: # Cases of the fetched corpora where the XML Schema step of a bundle that selects by scenario
# (XRechnung) and xmllint (libxml2 2.9.14), run on the schema of the scenario as the KoSIT
# configuration ships it (the `schema` column of the acceptance table that `cargo xtask
# xrechnung` writes), disagree on whether the document is schema-valid, each with its cause.
# tests/rules_equivalence.rs fails on any difference not listed here and on any listed one
# that no longer occurs (for the bundles it checks). The same differences of einvoice-xsd
# with xmllint are listed with the oracle of einvoice-xsd (crates/einvoice-xsd/tests/oracle/).

column3: A cbc:PayableAmount with 1000 fractional zeros. The value space of xs:decimal has no digit limit (XML Schema 1.0 Part 2 3.2.3); libxml2 rejects decimals of more than 24 significant digits, an implementation limit it does not document (decimal-25-digits-fraction in crates/einvoice-xsd/tests/oracle/disagreements.tsv). einvoice-xsd checks the lexical space without limit. The stylesheets reject the document all the same: invalid either way.

A ram:LineTotalAmount of 400 digits: libxml2 rejects decimals of more than 24 significant digits, as for payable-thousand-zeros above (mutation/long/huge-decimal in crates/einvoice-xsd/tests/oracle/cii/disagreements.tsv). Without schema errors, the stylesheet error of EN16931-CII (as Saxon-HE's) stops the validation.
As huge-decimal, with 400 fractional digits, which count towards the libxml2 limit of 24 digits. The stylesheets reject the document all the same: invalid either way.
